initial.lightMaterialIdentification: Exact runtime MeshBasicMaterial colors matched to existing factories; no new material factory/cache calls. Missing or occluded ROI is recorded, not treated as a style pass.

cityStats.ownership: Own emitted geometry, far instances and material clones; borrow all station atlases, far facade textures and gradient maps. Dispose before station.
cityStats.limitation: Background only: no new physics or navigable interiors. Foundations and stairs are CPU checked; camera composition and visible CDLOD contacts need GPU acceptance.

initial.method: Actual C12 scene and pinned nine assets. Main RAF frozen/time14; per view select once, AO .55 then0 only. Each state retains one warmup plus two fresh render captures. Each camera is copied from the actual C11 capture-2 reference; current preset definitions are retained as metadata. Current default service preset plus exact saved C8 legacy service world camera for identical HDR ROI comparison. 20/21 formulas and FOV58 match C8 AO experiment. No contrast ABA, UI/physics test, performance claim, source/material/quality/light replacement. No GPU tap or shadow-flag ABA. No full-frame identity assumed across revisions.
